## What changes

Describe the problem and resulting behavior, including a concrete example.

## Validation

List relevant checks and synthetic reproduction. For visual changes, include
live/still glass checks and screenshots without personal paths or filenames.

## Privacy and licensing

Confirm no private media, credentials or personal paths were added, and retain
licenses/notices for adapted code or assets. Public bundled binaries require the
separate distribution review described in docs/DISTRIBUTION.md.
